{{Quote|Is that some kind of homeground for those creatures?|Luke Skywalker to [[Josen Shire]]|<ref name="serpent" />}}
The '''Cavern of the Serpents''' was a cavern located deep within the [[Great Well]] of [[Ophideraan]] that served as the breeding ground and birthplace of the [[flying serpent]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that dominated Ophideraan's skies. The cavern, which was beneath the [[Slave level|living facilities]] of the [[Serpent Masters]]' [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], was often visited by desperate captives hoping to claim a serpent for their own and fly to freedom. In every case, they were captured by [[Supreme Serpent Master]] [[Tyrann]], and&mdash;with the exception of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]&mdash;immediately killed.<ref name="serpent" />
